title: Fix monthly time progression: Plank +15s per calendar month; Squash constant 45:00

requirements.text: Fix the monthly progression logic so that the habit named "Plank" (time unit) increases by exactly +15 seconds per calendar month (e.g., February 1:15, March 1:30, April 1:45), and the habit named "Squash" (time unit) remains constant at 45:00 for every calendar month. Do not change progression behavior for other habits.

quotes:
1. Yes correct so February 1:15, march 1:30, April 1:45 etc 
2. Yes correct 
3. Calendar months

acceptanceCriteria: When a user sets Plank’s volume for February to 1:15, the app shows March = 1:30 and April = 1:45 (and continues +15s for subsequent months), without unexpected jumps.
When a user sets Squash’s volume (in any month) to 45:00 (or 45), the app shows 45:00 for every month (Jan–Dec).
The month-to-month behavior is based on calendar months (Jan–Dec), not on a user-specific training-month counter.
Other habits keep their current compounding/increment rules and are unaffected by this change.
After saving and refreshing, Plank and Squash volumes remain correct (values are persisted and reloaded correctly).

requirements.text: Ensure time-based volume updates correctly preserve and/or initialize unit type as "time" so that time habits (including Plank and Squash) never compound using the default "reps" rules when a timeString is provided during an update.

quotes: Squash still not staying the same at 45 mins every month.

acceptanceCriteria: If a habit has no existing volumeTracking and an updateHabitVolume call includes a timeString, the stored volumeTracking.unitType is set to "time" (not left unset/defaulted to "reps").
For existing time habits, unitType remains "time" after volume updates.
This fix prevents incorrect monthly jumps caused by applying non-time increments to time-based habits.

requirements.text: Update the frontend’s optimistic volume compounding (used during volume edits) to match the corrected calendar-month rules for Plank (+15 seconds/month) and Squash (constant 45:00 across all months), while leaving other habits unchanged.

quotes: The time on plank and squash is still showing incorrectly - plank should increase by 15 seconds every month but for march it’s way higher than February and so on
Squash still not staying the same at 45 mins every month.

acceptanceCriteria: After editing Plank’s volume in the UI for a given month, the immediately-updated (optimistic) UI values for other months reflect the correct +15s/month progression based on calendar months.
After editing Squash’s volume in the UI, the immediately-updated (optimistic) UI values show 45:00 for all months.
The optimistic UI matches what is shown after the backend response/refresh (no mismatch between optimistic and persisted values).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if an actual stable-state upgrade is required.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not add new habit types, new progression schemes, or new calendar years/month models beyond fixing the specified Plank and Squash behaviors.
Do not change authentication (Internet Identity) behavior.
Do not redesign the UI beyond what is necessary to reflect correct values.
